description: This file defines the 'StepsScreen' widget for a Flutter app, which presents a list of problem-solving steps, including a problem statement card, a list of steps with expand/collapse functionality, and a sticky bottom CTA bar for navigation. It manages user interactions like viewing full solutions and navigating through steps.

classes.name: StepsScreen
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that displays a problem statement and an expandable list of steps with a sticky CTA bar.

classes.name: _ProblemCard
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that displays the problem text, source, and confidence level.

classes.name: _Tag
classes.description: A widget representing a tag with an icon and label for the problem attributes.

methods.name: _showFullSolution
methods.description: Builds and displays a modal bottom sheet containing the full list of steps with titles and bodies.
